User Story: As a hirer I want to sign up so that I can access the platform
Acceptance Criteria: Given I am on the sign-up page When I fill in valid details (name, email, phone, password) and submit Then my account is created and I am redirected to sign in

User Story: As a vendor I want to sign up so that I can list my venues on the platform
Acceptance Criteria: Given I am on the sign-up page When I select Vendor and fill in my business name, email, phone and password and submit Then my vendor account is created and I am redirected to sign in

User Story: As a user I want to see password validation feedback so that I know my password meets the requirements
Acceptance Criteria: Given I am filling in the password field When I type a password missing an uppercase letter, lowercase letter, or special character Then an error message is shown

User Story: As a user I want to sign in so that I can access my account
Acceptance Criteria: Given I have an existing account When I enter my correct email and password and click Sign In Then I am logged in and see a Welcome message with my name

User Story: As a user I want to sign out so that my session ends securely
Acceptance Criteria: Given I am logged in When I click Sign Out from the account menu Then I am logged out and redirected to the sign in page

User Story: As a hirer I want to view my profile so that I can see my account details and join date
Acceptance Criteria: Given I am logged in as a hirer When I click View Account in the account menu Then I see my name, email, phone number, and the date I joined

User Story: As a hirer I want to edit my profile so that I can keep my details up to date
Acceptance Criteria: Given I am on the profile page When I click Edit and update my first name, last name or phone number and save Then the updated details are saved and shown

User Story: As a hirer I want to browse all active venues so that I can find a place for my event
Acceptance Criteria: Given I am logged in as a hirer and on the Venues tab When the page loads Then I see all active venues with their name, location, capacity, price and image

User Story: As a hirer I want to search venues by name so that I can quickly find a specific venue
Acceptance Criteria: Given I am on the Venues tab When I type a venue name in the search box Then only venues with matching names are displayed

User Story: As a hirer I want to filter venues by suburb so that I can find venues in a preferred location
Acceptance Criteria: Given I am on the Venues tab When I type a suburb name in the location filter Then only venues in that suburb are displayed

User Story: As a hirer I want to filter venues by minimum capacity so that I can find venues large enough for my event
Acceptance Criteria: Given I am on the Venues tab When I enter a minimum capacity number Then only venues with capacity greater than or equal to that number are shown

User Story: As a hirer I want to filter venues by suitability keyword so that I can find venues suited to my event type
Acceptance Criteria: Given I am on the Venues tab When I select a keyword such as wedding or tennis from the suitability dropdown Then only venues tagged with that keyword are displayed

User Story: As a hirer I want to shortlist a venue so that I can save it and review it later
Acceptance Criteria: Given I am browsing venues When I click the shortlist button on a venue card Then the venue is added to my shortlist

User Story: As a hirer I want to remove a venue from my shortlist so that I can manage my saved venues
Acceptance Criteria: Given I am on the Shortlist tab When I click remove on a venue Then that venue is removed from my shortlist

User Story: As a hirer I want to view my shortlisted venues so that I can compare them before booking
Acceptance Criteria: Given I have shortlisted at least one venue When I go to the Shortlist tab Then I see all my saved venues with their details

User Story: As a hirer I want to submit a booking application for a venue so that I can request to use it for my event
Acceptance Criteria: Given I have selected a venue When I fill in the event name, date, number of guests and duration and submit Then a booking request is created with a Pending status

User Story: As a hirer I want to upload compliance documents with my booking so that the vendor can verify my application
Acceptance Criteria: Given I am on the booking form When I attach a driver's licence photo, liability insurance document, or ABN certificate Then they are submitted alongside my booking application

User Story: As a hirer I want to view my booking history so that I can track the status of my applications
Acceptance Criteria: Given I am logged in When I go to the History tab Then I see all my past and current bookings with their status (Pending, Approved, or Rejected)

User Story: As a hirer I want to leave a star rating and review for an approved booking so that I can provide feedback on the venue
Acceptance Criteria: Given my booking status is Approved When I select a star rating and optional comment and click Submit Review Then my review is saved and displayed in my booking history

User Story: As a vendor I want to create a new venue so that hirers can discover and book it
Acceptance Criteria: Given I am on the My Venues tab When I click Add Venue and fill in all required details and submit Then the new venue is created and appears in my list

User Story: As a vendor I want to edit my venue details so that the listing stays accurate and up to date
Acceptance Criteria: Given I am viewing my venues When I click Edit on a venue and update the details and save Then the changes are saved and reflected on the venue listing

User Story: As a vendor I want to deactivate a venue so that it is no longer visible to hirers
Acceptance Criteria: Given I am on the My Venues tab When I click Deactivate on a venue and confirm Then the venue is hidden from the hirer browse page

User Story: As a vendor I want to assign suitability keywords to my venue so that hirers can find it when filtering by event type
Acceptance Criteria: Given I am creating or editing a venue When I select suitability keywords such as wedding or dinner Then those keywords are saved and used when hirers filter venues

User Story: As a vendor I want to block a date range for a venue so that hirers cannot book it during that time
Acceptance Criteria: Given I am on the Blockouts tab When I select a venue and a start and end date and click Block Then that date range is blocked and shown in the active blockouts list

User Story: As a vendor I want to unblock a previously blocked date range so that the venue becomes available for booking again
Acceptance Criteria: Given I am on the Blockouts tab and there is an active blockout When I click Unblock on a blockout entry Then the blockout is removed and the venue is available again

User Story: As a vendor I want to view all booking applications for my venues so that I can review and manage them
Acceptance Criteria: Given I am on the Applications tab When the page loads Then I see all booking applications across all my venues with hirer details and event information

User Story: As a vendor I want to see a hirer's reputation score so that I can assess the quality of an applicant
Acceptance Criteria: Given I am viewing a booking application When I look at the booking card Then I see the hirer's star rating based on reviews they have received

User Story: As a vendor I want to see a hirer's compliance score so that I know how complete their documentation is
Acceptance Criteria: Given I am viewing a booking application When I look at the booking card Then I see a compliance score out of 5 based on how many documents the hirer has submitted

User Story: As a vendor I want to accept a booking application so that the hirer is confirmed for the venue
Acceptance Criteria: Given a booking is in Pending status When I click Approve Then the booking status changes to Approved

User Story: As a vendor I want to reject a booking application so that the hirer is informed it was unsuccessful
Acceptance Criteria: Given a booking is in Pending status When I click Reject Then the booking status changes to Rejected

User Story: As a vendor I want to see a bar chart of hirers per venue so that I can understand each venue's individual popularity
Acceptance Criteria: Given I am on the Analytics tab When I select the Bar chart view Then I see a bar chart showing each hirer's booking count for each of my venues

User Story: As a vendor I want to see a stacked bar chart of combined bookings so that I can compare total activity across all my venues
Acceptance Criteria: Given I am on the Analytics tab When I select the Stacked Bar chart view Then I see a stacked bar chart showing combined hirer tallies per venue

User Story: As a vendor I want to see a pie chart of hirer activity so that I can identify my most and least active hirers
Acceptance Criteria: Given I am on the Analytics tab When I select the Pie chart view Then I see a pie chart with each hirer's share of total bookings and a most active and least active highlight

User Story: As a vendor I want to see a line chart of venue utilization over time so that I can identify booking trends
Acceptance Criteria: Given I am on the Analytics tab When I select the Line chart view Then I see a line chart plotting the number of booking submissions per day over the selected period

User Story: As a vendor I want to filter all charts by time period so that I can compare activity across different timeframes
Acceptance Criteria: Given I am viewing the Analytics tab When I click This Week, This Month, Last Month, or All Time Then all charts update to show data only for that selected time period
